description: This file defines the 'Null' cache implementation for the HTMLPurifier project. It provides methods that do nothing but return false, indicating that no caching is performed.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Null
classes.description: A cache class that disables caching by always returning false for its operations.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Attempts to add a definition to the cache; always returns false as caching is disabled.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a definition in the cache; always returns false.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces a definition in the cache; always returns false.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a cache entry; always returns false.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache entry; always returns false.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Clears the cache; always returns false.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup tasks on the cache; always returns false.
